en: A sepia-toned postcard photograph of a Renaissance-style arcaded courtyard with multiple levels of round arches and balustrades. On the left is a domed tower-like structure with small windows and an external staircase; on the right, a long façade of repeating arches. The courtyard is mostly empty, with light and shadow on the ground. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location and publisher.
